parameters.content:
Full video draft + approval setup

1. Agent creates topic, script, scenes, thumbnail prompt, title, hashtags and keywords.
2. Voice API creates narration.
3. Visual API creates screen assets and thumbnail.
4. Video API edits/renders the vertical Short.
5. n8n downloads the MP4 and uploads it to YouTube as private.
6. Email goes to sajvindersingh8@gmail.com for approval.

Connect the YouTube OAuth credential for sajvindersingh8@gmail.com on the YouTube node. This workflow does not auto-publish.
